item.title: Eos Energy Enterprises Stock Plunges 39% After Q4 Earnings Miss Despite 7x Revenue Growth
item.description: Shares of Eos Energy Enterprises Inc. (NASDAQ: EOSE) cratered nearly 40% on Feb. 26, 2026, closing at $6.74 after the energy storage company reported fourth-quarter results that missed Wall Street expectations, even as full-year revenue surged more than sevenfold.

item.description: The fifth episode of FX's *Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. & Carolyn Bessette*, titled "Battery Park," aired Feb. 26, 2026, plunging viewers into the raw turbulence of the iconic couple's relationship as tabloid scrutiny and family pressures ignite a explosive public confrontation.

item.title: 'The Traitors' Season 4 Finale: Maura Higgins' Heartbreaking Betrayal as Rob Rausch Claims $220,800 Prize
item.description: Maura Higgins reached the explosive finale of *The Traitors* Season 4 on Feb. 26, only to suffer one of the show's most devastating betrayals when her closest ally, fellow *Love Island* star Rob Rausch, revealed himself as the last remaining Traitor and took the entire $220,800 prize pot.

item.title: Nu Holdings Stock Tumbles 9% After Strong Q4 Earnings as Investors Focus on Costs and Margins
item.description: Nu Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NU), the parent company of digital banking platform Nubank, saw its shares drop sharply Feb. 26, 2026, closing down 9.55% at $15.06 after reporting record fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results that beat revenue expectations but failed to fully satisfy investor demands for clearer margin signals and cost trends.

item.title: (VIDEO) Burger King Whopper Changes: Burger King Elevates Iconic Whopper with Premium Bun
item.description: Burger King announced Feb. 26, 2026, the first significant enhancements to its signature Whopper sandwich in nearly 10 years, responding directly to customer feedback with upgrades to the bun, mayonnaise and packaging while preserving the flame-grilled beef patty that defines the iconic item.

item.title: Australia's Top 10 Zoos: Best Wildlife Experiences for 2026 Ranked by Visitors and Experts
item.description: Australia's zoos and wildlife parks rank among the world's finest, blending conservation, education and immersive encounters with iconic native species like koalas, kangaroos, platypuses and crocodiles. As travel rebounds in 2026, these attractions draw millions seeking ethical wildlife viewing and family adventures.

item.title: Bitcoin Hovers Around $67,500 Amid Volatile Trading, Down from Recent Highs
item.description: Bitcoin, the world's leading cryptocurrency, was trading at approximately $67,500 USD on Friday, reflecting a modest pullback after a brief surge earlier in the week that briefly pushed it toward $70,000.

item.title: Netflix Shares Jump 9% After-Hours as Company Walks Away From Warner Bros. Discovery Deal
item.description: Netflix, Inc. (NFLX) shares surged nearly 9% in after-hours trading Thursday after the streaming leader announced it would not match a higher competing bid from Paramount Skydance for Warner Bros. Discovery, ending months of merger speculation.

item.title: (VIDEO) Marvel Actor Wyatt Russell Reveals Many Fans Still Don't Know Kurt Russell Is His Father
item.description: Wyatt Russell, the Marvel Cinematic Universe actor best known for portraying John Walker/U.S. Agent in Disney+ series and upcoming films, recently shared his surprise that many fans remain unaware he is the son of Hollywood legend Kurt Russell.

item.title: (VIDEO) Kelly Osbourne Calls Out 'Disgusting' Body-Shaming Comments as 'Abuse'
item.description: Kelly Osbourne forcefully denounced online body-shaming directed at her appearance, labeling the harsh remarks "disgusting" and a form of "abuse" in a series of Instagram Stories posts this week.
